disclaimer: Operational snapshot of jurisdictions and regions under comprehensive U.S. sanctions programs as of the effective date. Not a legal opinion. Not a claim that REACTOR is OFAC-compliant. Sectoral, list-based, and secondary programs are out of scope for this revision. Targeted Syrian persons/addresses are not a geo deny (issues #61 / #62). E.O. 14065 does not block the entire Donetsk or Luhansk oblasts (OFAC FAQ 1009).

programNotes.name: Syria
programNotes.citation: E.O. 14312 (2025-06-30); 31 CFR part 542 removed from the CFR (90 FR 41505, effective 2025-08-26)
programNotes.note: OFAC's comprehensive Syria Sanctions Program ended effective 2025-07-01 (E.O. 14312 revoked the six Syria program E.O.s). OFAC FAQ 1220; final rule removed 31 CFR part 542 on 2025-08-26. Remaining Syria restrictions are list-based/targeted (including E.O. 13894). Do not blanket-deny SY. Still-designated persons/addresses belong in #61 exact-list + #62 enforcement.

insufficientRegions.note: ISO 3166-2 UA-14 and oblast-level names identify the Donetsk oblast, not the so-called DPR Covered Region. FAQ 1009: E.O. 14065 does not block the entire oblast. Decision is UNKNOWN_REGION_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE, not DENY.

ISO 3166-2 UA-09 and oblast-level names identify the Luhansk oblast, not the so-called LPR Covered Region. FAQ 1009: E.O. 14065 does not block the entire oblast. Decision is UNKNOWN_REGION_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE, not DENY.
